title: 12/3/2026 ZBA Cancellation
text: 54111 BROUGHTON RD MACOMB TOWNSHIP MICHIGAN 48042 MACOMB TOWNSHIP 586.992.0710 EXT. 7103 WWW.MACOMB-MI.GOV PLANDROPBOX@MACOMB-MI.GOV PLANNING AND ZONING DEPARTMENT ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS NOTICE OF MEETING CANCELLATION DECEMBER 3, 2026 Please be advised that the regular meeting of the Zoning Board of Appeals scheduled for December 3, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. held in the Board Room of Macomb Township Offices located at 54111 Broughton Road, Macomb, MI 48042 has been cancelled by the Chairman due to a lack of agenda items being submitted. Questions about meeting dates and times can be directed to (586) 992-0710 Ext. 7103. Aaron Tuckfield, Chairman Zoning Board of Appeals
